setup.zh: 翻过山，是石纽。山坳里一个小池，池边的石头上刻着字：禹生于此。池底卧着一口鼎，鼎口盖着石板，板上刻着三个脚印，一前一后又一前——禹步。脚印后面本该有迹，都被磨平了。
setup.en: Over the hill lies Shiniu. In a hollow is a small pool, and on a stone beside it is cut: Yu was born here. At its bottom lies a cauldron, its mouth covered by a slab cut with three footprints — one ahead, one behind, one ahead: the Pace of Yu. Behind the footprints there should be traces; they have been worn away.

recap.zh: 石纽的洗儿池底卧着一口鼎，石板上刻着禹步的三个脚印，后面的迹被磨平了。
recap.en: At the bottom of the Washing Pool at Shiniu lay a cauldron; its slab bore the three footprints of the Pace of Yu, the traces behind them worn away.

text.zh: 禹生在这里。他走路一跛一跛的——治水累的。后来的人学他走，叫禹步。
text.en: Yu was born here. He walked with a limp — worn out taming the waters. Those who came after copied his walk and called it the Pace of Yu.

alone.zh: 禹生在这里。他治水跛了腿，后人学他走路，叫禹步。
alone.en: Yu was born here. Taming the waters left him lame; later people copied his walk and called it the Pace of Yu.

label.en: Read the seal · Count the Pace

exits.means: reads the seal, answers how many traces the Pace of Yu leaves

text.zh: 你报出那个数。三个脚印后面，一个接一个地亮出了迹。石板沉进池底。鼎口的气冲上来——是雪山水的味道，和刚落地的婴儿的味道。
text.en: You give the number. Behind the three footprints the traces light up one after another. The slab sinks into the pool. The cauldron's breath rushes up — snowmelt, and the smell of a newborn.

exits.means: tries to break, lift or pry the slab by force

text.zh: 石板不动。三个脚印在你掌下一跛一跛地亮。
text.en: The slab does not move. Under your palm the three footprints light up, limping.
